text: 7月15日，人民银行副行长邹澜在国新办新闻发布会上表示，现阶段7天期逆回购操作利率还是主要政策利率。从实践效果来看，也较好发挥了市场定价锚的作用。
text_en: On July 15, PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan said at a State Council Information Office press conference that at this stage, the 7-day reverse repo rate remains the main policy rate, effectively serving as a market pricing anchor based on practical results.
